CustomField.description: Whether the language on this record is the approved language. Source versions are Approved once they pass the Activate action. A quote instance inherits Approved because its body is a copy of the source. Editing the body of a quote instance makes it a Custom Quote Instance and sets this to Not Approved, because the language on the quote is no longer the language that was approved.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by automation. A term whose body has been customized for this deal reads Not Approved until it is approved.
CustomField.label: Approval Status
